508:t_1:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...This planet's agent has disappointed me.」

508:t_1:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Earthlings only have shallow schemes after all. I lent him someone with highly concentrated spirit quanta, and he couldn't even produce decent results.」

508:t_1:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Or should we consider $c exceptional?」

508:t_1:8.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「That would be more reasonable.」

508:t_1:9.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「What matters more is that people who reached this level have been left unchecked.」

508:t_1:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Considering whose jurisdiction this universe is, that's inevitable. They even used a dimensional cage here.」

508:t_1:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What are you talking about?」

508:t_1:12.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It doesn't concern you yet.」

508:t_1:13.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're hard on newcomers, Your Majesty. So you'll treat me like a novice until I bring you the $$いがみ合う双子$$?」

508:t_1:14.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「If you understand that, I have nothing to add.」

508:t_1:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Stay out of this, $$アムブリエル$$. They're my prey.」

508:t_1:17.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Am I staying behind?」

508:t_1:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll dispose of your darling $n while I'm at it.」

508:t_1:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't worry. I'll bring back that $$ジェミニオン$$ thing. You can use it to become the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$リアクター$$.」

508:t_1:20.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So you do acknowledge my power to some extent.」

508:t_1:21.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get carried away. I'm not the one who decides whether you truly deserve to call yourself $$アムブリエル$$.」

508:t_1:22.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...I'm grateful you brought me to the surface, but I can't see us having much fun together.」

508:t_1:23.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Heh... She's an interesting woman.」

508:t_1:24.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If she didn't have the factor, I'd kill her right now.」

508:t_1:25.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Without that much spirit, she wouldn't deserve a place at this table.」

508:t_1:26.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「In that sense, all of $c's $$リアクター$$s have the requisite power, including the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

508:t_1:27.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So they're approaching the third stage?」

508:t_1:28.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Still, I never expected us to find two humans who could awaken the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

508:t_1:29.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It must be due to the peculiar nature of this planet, Earth.」

508:t_1:31.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Is it because the $$オリジン・ロー$$s gather here...? Or do the $$オリジン・ロー$$s gather here because of that...?」

508:t_1:32.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「And the power of this planet's humans is gradually taking shape...」

508:t_1:33.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$c's movements across the world are opening cracks in our battle lines. If this continues, the tide could turn.」

508:t_1:34.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then I'll cut it off at the root.」

508:t_1:35.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$c and $$ネオ・ジオン$$... This should prove interesting.」

508:t_1:36.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... You refuse to acknowledge your own roots?」

508:t_1:42.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...$$グエン$$ is an agent of $$クロノ$$...」

508:t_1:43.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「$$ロラン・セアック$$... He asked me to give you his regards.」

508:t_1:44.en:
$$オットー$$
「Who is this man, $$グエン$$?」

508:t_1:46.en:
$$ブライト$$
「He's the heir of an influential local family, and a very ambitious man.」

508:t_1:47.en:
$$ブライト$$
「He's also sharp, and handled negotiations with the $$ムーンレィス$$ as they began descending to Earth, but...」

508:t_1:48.en:
$$ブライト$$
「He tried to use the contacts and relics of past civilizations he acquired to further his ambitions, and ultimately opposed $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$.」

508:t_1:49.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He disappeared after parting with $$万丈$$ and $$ロジャー$$ during the battle against 《$$エグゼクター$$》. I never imagined he'd joined $$クロノ$$...」

508:t_1:50.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I suppose it's just like him.」

508:t_1:51.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「He called himself a newcomer, so his family probably isn't tied to $$クロノ$$ like the $$マーセナス家$$.」

508:t_1:52.en:
$$ロラン$$
($$グエン$$... What in the world are you thinking...?)

508:t_1:53.en:
$$オットー$$
「Colonel $$ブライト$$... What shall we do about pursuing Senator $$ローナン・マーセナス$$?」

508:t_1:54.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It would probably be futile. He's too powerful for us to act on Ensign $$リディ$$'s words alone.」

508:t_1:55.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If we handle this poorly, suspicion could cause the half-ruined $$地球連邦$$ government to collapse completely.」

508:t_1:56.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Conservatives are merely a subordinate organization of $$サイデリアル$$. A victory over the Empire would make their existence meaningless.」

508:t_1:57.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「So we should focus on bringing the war against the Empire to a swift end.」

508:t_1:58.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$... Were you in $$ラース・バビロン$$ after the Empire captured you in $$オーブ$$?」

508:t_1:59.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Yes... There were people gathered from all around the world there, besides us.」

508:t_1:60.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「They were probably meant to be used in the $$霊子吸収システム$$ you just told me about.」

508:t_1:61.en:
$$オットー$$
「They specifically intended to use the Vice Foreign Minister, Princess $$マリナ$$, and Representative $$アスハ$$ for that?」

508:t_1:62.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「This may sound inappropriate, but I would think there are more effective uses for them, such as this hostage operation...」

508:t_1:63.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「That must be because we were the people they wanted... We had large quantities of these spirit quanta.」

508:t_1:64.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$ had no interest in our titles or positions. He seemed to seek only strong people... people with abundant spirit quanta.」

508:t_1:66.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Yes, though none of our words reached him...」

508:t_1:67.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But, Vice Foreign Minister... I'm glad we've been able to welcome you back like this.」

508:t_1:68.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We will now move to contain $$ネオ・ジオン$$, so we'll escort you to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

508:t_1:69.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「I understand. I'll help $$ミネバ$$ there too.」

508:t_1:70.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We'll be departing shortly, but please feel free to spend time with $$ヒイロ$$ until then.」

508:t_1:71.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Thank you for your consideration.」

508:t_1:72.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「But he has already given me ample strength. I would delay your departure, so I'll simply see you off.」

508:t_1:74.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Please tell everyone that Princess $$マリナ$$, $$ナナリー$$, and Representative $$アスハ$$ are all safe.」

508:t_1:75.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I understand. We'll prepare as quickly as possible and rescue the people held captive in $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

508:t_1:80.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...I heard about that rich boy, $$ロラン$$.」

508:t_1:82.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Well... I don't really know how to put it... Don't let it get to you too much.」

508:t_1:83.en:
$$シン$$
「I was actually kind of impressed myself... Like, how far can he go?」

508:t_1:85.en:
$$シン$$
「Wh-what...!? I was trying to cheer $$ロラン$$ up...」

508:t_1:86.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Even so, choose your words more carefully! You're always so insensitive, $$シン$$!」

508:t_1:87.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Thank you, $$ルナマリア$$. But I'm all right.」

508:t_1:88.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...Actually, I was... thinking the same thing as $$シン$$.」
